messages.author: 12f269733c6eb9a2
messages.subject: Re: maximum observations in MCDS
parts:
Kristine:

Because the MCDS engine in Distance is compiled FORTRAN code, the
dimensions of various arrays is limited to 100,000. In the mists of
time, I recall another user who exceeded this number of observations. I
will check with the development team whether a compiled version with
larger dimensions might still exist.

Depending upon what you are trying to accomplish with MCDS, you might
see whether MRDS running within R might be capable of dealing with your
dataset.

messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Re: maximum observations in MCDS
parts:
Hi Kristine, (cc Eric and list)

I can easily compile a version with a higher limit -- I'll do so and send to
you. I don't want to make a larger version generally available as (1) because
MCDS is an old FORTRAN program with fixed sides arrays then having higher
maximum numbers means a bigger memory footprint, and for almost everyone 100,000
observations is enough; (2) I've made a few changes to the code that I'd like to
release in a new version of Distance soon.

If anyone else needs a version with a higher limit than 100,000 observations (or
any of the other limits) just email me.

Cheers - Len
